title: Expenses on autopilot
label: A list of four features beside a product card. As each feature's progress line fills, the card for a £17 taxi expense generates a memo, fills in its category, flags and then approves a policy exception, and syncs to the ledger.

steps.title: Stop chasing receipts.
steps.body: Receipts match themselves and the memo writes itself, with less admin and chasing.

steps.title: Categorise expenses automatically.
steps.body: Category, department and location are filled in from the transaction.

steps.title: Only review the exceptions.
steps.body: Anything outside policy is flagged once, with the reason, and approved in a tap.

steps.title: Keep your books current.
steps.body: Every approved expense lands in the ledger the same day.
